اقترعن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَعْنَ (iqtaraʕna) /iq.ta.raʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# اُقْتُرِعْنَ (uqturiʕna) /uq.tu.riʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# اِقْتَرِعْنَ (iqtariʕna) /iq.ta.riʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
